81566.subject: Inboxes for agents, and a faster sending infrastructure
81566.body:
Hey, it's Zeno.

This month, we launched Inboxes for agents and teams https://resend.com/blog/announcing-inboxes?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=inline_link, a faster sending infrastructure https://resend.com/blog/announcing-resend-forge?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=inline_link, a new program for nonprofits https://resend.com/blog/introducing-resend-for-nonprofits?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=inline_link, and hosted our first conference, Resend Forward https://resend.com/blog/resend-forward-2026-recap?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=inline_link: a conference centered on crafting high-quality software.

Quick question:

> What's one thing you've always wanted us to build?

Have ideas? Hit reply. We read every answer.





THE INBOX FOR AGENTS

https://resend.com/blog/announcing-inboxes?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=image

At Resend Forward, we launched Inboxes. Built for agents, but ready for your whole team. Every message is grouped into a thread, and every thread is available to your app, your team, and your agents.

→ Read the announcement https://resend.com/blog/announcing-inboxes?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=button





THE NEXT GENERATION OF EMAIL INFRASTRUCTURE

https://resend.com/blog/announcing-resend-forge?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=image

Announcing Resend Forge, our own email infrastructure (i.e., Mail Transfer Agent). It's reliable, fast, and provides best-in-class deliverability. Forge sends from IP blocks we own and operate. We control the whole path, from the API you call down to the addresses your email leaves from.

→ Learn about Forge https://resend.com/blog/announcing-resend-forge?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=button





ADD EMAIL TO YOUR LARAVEL APP

https://resend.com/changelog/laravel-cloud-integration?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=button

This month we introduced the Laravel Cloud integration. Add Resend as a resource on your Laravel Cloud canvas, sign in with OAuth, and your environment is ready to send.

→ View the integration https://resend.com/changelog/laravel-cloud-integration?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=button





RESEND FOR NONPROFITS

https://resend.com/blog/introducing-resend-for-nonprofits?utm_source=broadcast&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_10_product_newsletter&utm_content=image

Nonprofits rely on email to run effectively, but every dollar they spend on email
